insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options: INR 2 Lacs, 3 Lacs, 4 Lacs, 5 Lacs, 7 Lacs, 10 Lacs, 15 Lacs, 20 Lacs, 25 Lacs, 50 Lacs, 75 Lacs, 1 Crore, 2 Crores, 3 Crores, 4 Crores, 5 Crores, 6 Crores (overall Sum Insured may include Super Reload, Super Credit, Cancer Booster etc. as applicable)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote:
Room Rent
Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One VYTL)
great.explanation: Hospital room charges are paid at actual cost up to the sum insured without any capping. This means you can choose any room without worrying about daily limits.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote:
C.10 Super Reload
... provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured (“Super Reload”), unlimited times during the Policy Year... 
From 2nd claim of Policy Life - Unlimited times
great.reference: Section C.10 Super Reload; Annexure III - Product Benefit Table
great.explanation: If your sum insured is exhausted, the insurer reloads the base sum insured unlimited times from the second claim onwards. This ensures you have extra coverage for multiple claims in a year.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One VYTL); Section C.4 Claim Protect
great.explanation: Non-payable hospital items like gloves and syringes are covered as per the specified lists. This reduces your out-of-pocket expenses during hospitalization.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Medical expenses for the same illness are covered up to 90 days before hospital admission. This longer period helps cover diagnostic and treatment costs before hospitalization.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote:
C.11 Super Credit
... will be applied / increased by a fixed percentage of the Base Sum Insured of immediately preceding Policy Year irrespective of any claims in previous Policy Year...
great.explanation: Your sum insured can increase on renewal regardless of claims made, subject to policy caps. This gives you extra coverage over time even if you claim.

great.name: NCB
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One VYTL); Section C.11 Super Credit
great.explanation: The renewal bonus increases your sum insured even if you have made claims, so it does not reset to zero. This rewards policyholders continuously.

great.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
great.explanation: Expenses for follow-up treatment after discharge are covered up to 180 days. This helps with recovery costs over a longer period.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Waiting Period - Inbuilt Cover)
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 3 years of continuous coverage. This is within the standard 2 to 4 years waiting period.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: A 24-month waiting period applies for specified illnesses and procedures. This is a common market standard.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote:
D.1.3 30-day Waiting Period (Code-Excl03)
Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents. This is a typical initial waiting period.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote:
C.5 Domiciliary Hospitalization
The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Period on Domiciliary Hospitalization...
good.explanation: Treatment at home when hospital admission is not possible is covered, subject to conditions like minimum 3 days. This provides flexibility for home care.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote:
C.13 Chronic Management Program (OPD)
... entitled to avail access to a fixed number of (i) Medical Practitioner’s consultations and (ii) diagnostic tests... as specified in the Policy Schedule. For details... refer Annexure IV
bad.reference: Section C.13 Chronic Management Program (OPD); Annexure IV
bad.explanation: Coverage for chronic conditions is limited to a fixed number of consultations and tests. This restricts access to ongoing care.

bad.name: Non-medical Expenses
bad.quote:
D.2.5 Non-Medical Expenses
As mentioned under Annexure (I), items in List I, II, III & IV will be excluded unless forms a part of In-patient hospitalization.
bad.explanation: Non-medical items are generally excluded unless Claim Protect is active. This may lead to out-of-pocket costs if you lack that cover.

bad.name: Home Health Care
bad.quote:
C.6 Home Health Care
... The treatment is pre-authorized by the Company...
This Benefit requires pre-authorisation and is not available on reimbursement basis.
bad.explanation: Home health care requires pre-authorization and cannot be claimed on reimbursement. This limits flexibility in availing home treatments.

bad.name: Cashless Network
bad.quote: We reserve the right to modify, add or restrict any Network Provider for Cashless Facilities at Our sole discretion.
bad.reference: Section E.2.7.1 (a) For Availing Cashless Facility
bad.explanation: The insurer can change the cashless hospital network at any time. You must verify network status before admission.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote:
D.2.6 Specific treatment Exclusion
Treatment involving Rotational Field Quantum Magnetic Resonance (RFQMR), External Counter Pulsation (ECP), Enhanced External Counter Pulsation (EECP), Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy, KTP Laser Surgeries, Cyber Knife Treatment, Femto Laser Surgeries, Bioabsorbable Stents, Bioabsorbable Valves, Bioabsorbable Implants. Use of Radio Frequency (RF) probe for ablation.
bad.explanation: Several modern therapies and procedures are explicitly excluded. You should confirm if your planned treatment is covered.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote:
C.15.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
... bear a Co-Payment of 10% on each and every claim... (only if treatment is taken in a Hospital other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”)
bad.reference: Section C.15.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
bad.explanation: A 10% co-pay applies if treatment is outside the preferred network, but the base plan co-pay is not clearly stated. Clarification is needed to understand your default co-pay liability.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
